name: Steam (instant resume)
purpose: The user's Steam client in the PowOS session (native ARM64, games through FEX; its package is x86-games'). Started once, then frozen (cgroup v2 freezer: no CPU, kept in RAM) 15 s after it's out of sight - unfocused, minimized, closed to the tray, or PowOS off screen - and thawed before it's shown again (its launch paths: /usr/bin/steam, powos-open-task, focus). A game it runs sleeps with it (games: pause): the game's windows count as Steam's, so a game out of sight for 15 s is frozen together with the client (0% CPU, kept in RAM), and launching it again (/usr/bin/steam steam://rungameid/<appid>, `powos game <name> thaw`) thaws both and raises the game's window instead of a cold Proton start. Never frozen in its first 2 minutes or a game's (update, login, the launch it was started for, Proton's start), or while it reads/writes the disk (downloads, updates, installs). docs/UNIFIED-SLEEP.md (Steam). Started once per session out of sight by the package's autostart (/etc/xdg/autostart/powos-steam-resident.desktop -> /usr/lib/powos-steam/powos-steam-resident, 60 s after login, `steam -silent`), so a game's first tap skips Steam's own ~22 s start. Proton gets PowOS's user_settings.py (/usr/lib/powos-steam/user_settings.py, copied into each Proton by /usr/bin/steam): Steam's install script evaluator is skipped when nothing changed since its last good run. Each game runs the fastest way that worked: its native Linux build, ARM64 Proton or x86 Proton (/usr/bin/powos-steam-compat: per-game policy + measured launches in ~/.local/share/powos/steam-compat.json, written into config.vdf by /usr/bin/steam before each Steam start; `powos game <x> compat`). /usr/lib/powos-steam/steam-env (+ ~/.config/powos/steam-env): environment for Steam and every game.
unbounded: the user's Steam and the games it starts take what they need; a cgroup of its own would also keep powos-sleepd from freezing it (it moves only processes in the root v2 cgroup)

commands: touch ~/.config/powos/steam-resident-off (no Steam start at login; a game's tap still starts it)
powos sleep never steam (keeps Steam awake; the unit's manifest can stay)
rm /etc/powos/units.d/steam.json (Steam then follows the generic 10 min GUI rule)
